text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~~, so this is Brian-san's regular 
hangout~. It's pretty dark.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Don't follow me on your own and then 
complain.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But there are no customers at all, and the 
vibe feels kind of heavy――

text_block_list.name: Livehouse Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Brian-san? Sorry, but today's a 
rehearsal day for the band, so we aren't 
letting customers in.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so that was it! No wonder it felt so 
weird... wait.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh, where are you going, Brian-san?

text_block_list.name: Band Leader
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Who're you? Outsiders aren't allowed 
back here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What happened to the bassist?

text_block_list.name: Band Leader
text_block_list.text:
............ She quit. Said she lost her 
passion for it.

text_block_list.name: Band Drummer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, we gotta rearrange 
everything into a three-piece for next 
week's live show. It's a real pain, 
seriously.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whaaat... Isn't that super crazy hard?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's a live show, so it's not just 
one song, right? Doing all of them from 
scratch right now is...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —Oh, I know! Maya just had a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
How about Brian-san joins in? Her bass 
playing is super amazing, you know!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't just go making decisions on 
your—

text_block_list.name: Band Drummer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that might actually work! If she blows 
everyone away with a killer performance, 
maybe that'll make her want to come back 
out of spite—

text_block_list.name: Band Leader
text_block_list.text: That's enough.

text_block_list.name: Band Leader
text_block_list.text:
We don't need outsiders in our band. 
Besides, there's no way someone who can 
just play well could ever keep up with our 
sound—

text_block_list.name: Band Leader
text_block_list.text:
...Kh?! No way, how can you play our songs 
so effortlessly...?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What will it be? ...Make up your mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the day of the live—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAHHHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaa~~!! Brian-sa~n!! Everyone looks so 
cool too~~!!

text_block_list.name: Band Leader
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Alright, the next one is 
finally our last... wait, hey! What are 
you doing out of nowhere—

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, crazy, a bass solo?!" "That sound 
is insane! It's rumbling right in my gut!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Hey, are you listening, runaway? I've got 
a piece of advice for you—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Don't turn your eyes away from your 
instinctual urges.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much you tell yourself the 
fire is gone, those smoldering embers will 
eventually scorch your insides.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
So listen to this sound. Feel this 
impulse—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
There is no hunger that can be satisfied 
by running away...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaaah~~!! Brian-san, you're suuuper 
cool~~!!

text_block_list.name: Audience?
text_block_list.text: ~~~~kh, dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was so deeply moving!! 
Seriously, it was the best live ever~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph, that much was nothing special.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted two familiar horse 
girls, and a mysterious figure watching 
them closely.
choice_data_list: Do you need something from those two?

text_block_list.name: Audience?
text_block_list.text: Kh! Shut up, it's none of your business!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Did I end up startling them? I could only 
watch in a daze as they ran away.
